products.title: Chair - Tia - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Designed by Antonino Sciortino, Tia is an outdoor chair that marks a tribute to the simplest and most perfect lightness and elegance. The chair's sinuous silhouette, accentuated by a matt black stainless steel rod frame, captures attention with its understated, essential elegance, while its rounded form, a hallmark of the collection, conveys a welcoming character. Crafted for outdoor environments like terraces and gardens, as well as for indoor areas seeking a minimalist flair, Tia seamlessly merges resilience with elegance, offering an ideal combination of aesthetics, comfort, and practicality.

products.title: Chair - Rimini - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The outdoor chairs of the Rimini collection by Paola Navone recall the timeless charm of the city synonymous with Italian holidays, a place that encapsulates the essence of summer. Featuring a refined vintage-inspired design, these leather chairs reinterpret the iconic atmosphere of the seaside resort, conveying a sense of enduring and understated elegance. Crafted with a sturdy tubular copper structure, the Rimini chairs come in two versions: Outdoor, showcasing a verdigris finish paired with a long-lasting and refined Aku leather seat, perfect for elegant outdoor settings; and Open-Air, boasting an antique copper structure with a Hydro leather seat, ideal for blending seamlessly into semi-sheltered areas.

products.title: Chair - Mati - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Solid and sophisticated, the Mati Outdoor chair stands out for its tubular structure in acid-etched copper that gives an authentic and refined look. The minimalist design, absent of any intertwining, highlights the purity of the forms and the visual lightness. The seat features a non-removable back cushion, available in leather or outdoor fabrics. Available in Lido leather or outdoor fabric. Mati Outdoor is crafted to adorn gardens, terraces, and sheltered outdoor areas with a sleek, modern aesthetic, providing an experience of sophistication.

products.title: Chair - Linfa - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: The most notable trait of Linfa outdoor seating is its unconventional irony. An approach that takes form in the harmonious balance of geometries, in the minimalist design of Studiopepe which interprets the contemporary outdoors in an unusual way: simple, timeless forms that stem from classic canons. Resting on a solid, painted swivel base, the stools and chairs in natural or black iroko wood invite us to reimagine our approach to the outdoors as a creative, rich opportunity to be explored in every season.

products.title: Chair - Leggia - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Leggia is an outdoor leather chair designed by Antonino Sciortino with the idea of combining elegance and minimalism in a strong and light seat, suitable for open air and outdoor spaces. Thanks to the sleek design of the stainless steel rods, the clean, minimalist silhouette of the frame contrasts with the comfort of the seat – upholstered in Aku leather for the Outdoor version and Hydro for the Open-Air version – which, suspended like a fabric, is ready to welcome those who sit down. The warm, natural colour of the outdoor leather adds depth, while the matt black painted steel emphasises the strong character of the chair, which blends into any context while maintaining a discreet and sophisticated beauty.

products.title: Chair - Himba - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Himba collection redefines domestic and outdoor spaces with ethnic-inspired chairs in natural, organic shapes that recall the typical motifs of African design and art. Delicate and harmonious, the solid wood seats designed by Roberto Lazzeroni elevate interiors in the version with leather cushions and can also be used on the terrace and in the garden when upholstered in weatherproof fabric or leather.

products.title: Chair - Dabliou - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Designed by Studiopepe for Baxter, the Dabliou chair is an outdoor piece that distils the spirit of Italy’s legendary 1960s beach resorts into a contemporary expression of sophisticated elegance. Its silhouette, defined by a coloured tubular structure, creates a dialogue between formal purity and precision in proportion. The result is a design that feels both visually light and structurally impeccable. The padding, crafted to coexist with the natural elements and endure their shifting moods, welcomes the body in a soft, embracing gesture—never compromising on aesthetic clarity or elegance. Dabliou transforms terraces, gardens, verandas, and dining spaces into unique settings—where signature design meets functionality, elevating the outdoor living experience. An iconic piece, versatile and expressive, perfect both on its own and combined with other elements to compose elegant and cohesive outdoor spaces.

products.title: Armchair - Sellerina Alluminium - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Created from a one-piece unit in polished cast aluminium, the armchair Sellerina Alluminium by Paola Navone evokes the comfortable charm of more classic furniture, reinterpreting it with a completely innovative design sensibility. Inspired by elegant seats with a retro flavour, Sellerina embodies a contemporary vision of the art de vivre, combining sinuous and cosy shapes with unusual details and materials. The polished aluminium of the structure lends the design a bold lightness and surprising brilliance, enhancing its scenic presence. Sellerina Alluminium reinterprets the armchair as an eclectic and distinctive decorative piece, where minimalist lines and perfect proportions blend seamlessly with the metal's polished surface, equally honouring comfort and beauty.

products.title: Armchair - Montreal - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: An invitation to comfort and relaxation outside the home, Montreal is Paola Navone's large upholstered outdoor armchair that is an ode to elegance in outdoor spaces. The generous dimensions of the soft upholstery offer a pleasant feeling of refuge and cosiness, making the armchair the ideal companion for relaxing in the garden, on the terrace or by the pool. The practicality of the non-slip rubber base and the versatility of the removable cover in a water-repellent material of your choice offer security, durability, and the possibility to customise each piece.

products.title: Armchair - Montreal - Paola Navone
products.description_html: An invitation to comfort and relaxation outside the home, Montreal is Paola Navone's large upholstered outdoor armchair that is an ode to elegance in open-air spaces. The generous dimensions of the soft upholstery offer a pleasant feeling of refuge and cosiness, making the armchair the ideal companion for relaxing in the garden, on the terrace or by the pool. The practicality of the non-slip rubber base and the versatility of the removable cover in a water-repellent material of your choice offer security, durability, and the possibility to customise each piece.

products.title: Armchair - Himba - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Himba collection redefines interiors and exteriors with ethnic-inspired and natural looking furniture. Sofas, loungers and armchairs designed by Roberto Lazzeroni to become majestic presences in the home as well as in the garden, blending into nature and acquiring character and meaning over time. Remarkably delicate and made even more welcoming by the cushions, the pieces in the collection are like exotic sculptures and can be used both in the living room and outside the home thanks to the leather (indoor or outdoor) and fabric (outdoor) covers.

products.title: Armchair - Hakuna Matata - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Hakuna Matata is the solid wood armchair designed by Roberto Lazzeroni to celebrate moments of quiet relaxation both indoors and out. The name itself is a statement of intent: “carefree” in Swahili, it advocates a slower and more rejuvenating approach to moments of relaxation and rest. Its reassuring sculpted design is inspired by African art and its alternation of defined and compact curves invites us to abandon ourselves in its generous embrace.

products.title: Chair - Green Point - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Timeout Collection offers a wide range of seating: in addition to the two-cushion sofa in two sizes, there is also a generously proportioned armchair and a table chair with a slender.

In the seating, the theme of the band of burnished painted aluminium, the fil rouge of the collection, is taken up again in a more leisurely rhythm to create the structure. The bending of the band draws the shape of the backrest and sled bases, with dynamic, agile and angular profiles. A dense, handcrafted polypropylene rope cover is woven onto the metal frame in anthracite, olive green and desert yellow.

products.title: Armchair - Phoenix - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Timeout Collection offers a wide range of seating: in addition to the two-cushion sofa in two sizes, there is also a generously proportioned armchair and a table chair with a slender, aerial profile, both available with or without armrests, and the result of a careful study of ergonomics.

In the seating, the theme of the band of burnished painted aluminium, the fil rouge of the collection, is taken up again in a more leisurely rhythm to create the structure. The bending of the band draws the shape of the backrest and sled bases, with dynamic, agile and angular profiles.

A dense, handcrafted polypropylene rope cover is woven onto the metal frame in anthracite, olive green and desert yellow. In addition to the armchair and chairs, the range includes a large array of products, such as a dining table with seats, a stool, a comfortable sunbed, side tables and a bench.

products.title: Armchair - Petalo - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
With the Petalo armchair and pouf, Vincent Van Duysen enhances the Outdoor Timeout Collection with gentle curves and delicately enveloping seating. A testament to the artistry inherent in the collection, these designs create reimagine outdoor atmospheres thanks to their inviting aesthetic.

To achieve its abundant lightness, Petalo features a solid aluminum base in a distinctive merlot red color, carefully chosen for its recyclability. This aligns seamlessly with the Molteni Group's unwavering commitment to sustainability.

The backrest, available in high and low versions, becomes a canvas for the intricate dance of polypropylene fiber ribbons. These ropes, reminiscent of nautical elements, add a touch of elegance while being resistant to water and challenging climates.

The enveloping seat cushion caters to diverse aesthetic tastes and ergonomic needs. The low backrest version comes with small, padding-free yet comfortable cushions, while the high backrest version can be configured with a large spoke cushion that lines the frame’s perimeter, seamlessly integrating with the seat to elevate the level of comfort.

For added creativity, the comfortable pouf provides an additional surface, complementing the armchair and enhancing the overall outdoor experience.

A celebration of al fresco living through a harmonious blend of design, comfort, and sustainability, Petalo marks another iconic addition to Vincent Van Duysen's timeless vision for the Outdoor Collection.

products.title: Outdoor Armchair - D.154.2 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
One of Gio Ponti's most iconic and representative pieces, designed in 1954 for the Planchart collectors' villa in Caracas (1953-57), is now available in an outdoor version. The careful study of materials and technical performance guarantee not only respect for the valuable original design, but also the durability that characterises all Molteni&C products.

The D.154.2 is a wrap-around armchair with a sinuous profile, characterised by a rigid yet cosy shell juxtaposed with a soft upholstered counter frame. The essence of the chair originates from the subtle play of curved lines and the harmonious contrast between rigid and soft elements that make it timeless.

products.title: Armchair - D.150.5 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
In collaboration with the Gio Ponti Archives and the heirs of the renowned Milanese architect, Molteni&C is reconstructing one of the rare pieces of furniture Gio Ponti designed for outdoor use: the D.150.5 chaise longue projects for the cruise ship Andrea Doria in 1952.

This edition is a tribute to Ponti's work for the Andrea Doria, where he was able to create exceptional environments with his multifaceted creativity. The chaise longue, "dreamed up" and designed by Ponti, is an important exponent of this representation, which anticipates, by seizing the opportunity of the ship's unconventional environments, precisely the continuous and modifiable spaces of his architecture of later years, where the furnishings participate in the domestic theatre without constructing fixed sets, as could be the case for living room or bedroom furniture, but rather responding to and representing in their design the comforts and needs of those who would use them.

A synthesis of values that resolves itself into an aesthetic, as Ponti teaches.
The contours of our chaise longue are characterised by two distinctive features: the first is the continuous line of the side design that unites the different parts (backrest, seat, armrest, footrest) in a single stroke, marking the elongated profile of the armchair in accordance with the Pontian principle.

The second detail is the radius of the angle between the seat and the backrest, which is identical to that of Ponti's precisely stated in the construction notes of the '53 Distex now issued by Molteni&C as D.153.1. The use of solid teak highlights the production merits of high quality cabinet making.

products.title: Armchair - Palinfrasca - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The themes that identify the Landmark Collection - the curved, enveloping lines of the solid teak frame and the macro-scale warp and weft pattern - remain in the armchair and, thanks to the more compact proportions, become even clearer and more expressive.

The curved backrest is like an embrace that envelops the user, enhancing the idea of protective and cosy comfort. As in the modular sofa elements, the backrest can be woven in teak or EVA polyurethane in olive green. As in the sofas, the seat cushioning provides enveloping comfort.

products.title: Armchair - Boboli - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
A Vincent Van Duysen original, the Boboli armchair is an iconic and innovative creation characterized by its light and airy lines, seamlessly blending with the outdoor environment.

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Boboli chair showcases a solid teak wood frame and seat, perfectly capturing the fusion of nature and design embodied by Molteni&C Outdoor Collection. The backrest, woven by hand using polypropylene fiber ribbons in ecru employs superior craftsmanship to create a natural effect.

Allowing for a personalized touch, Boboli’s seat and back cushioning are fully customizable from an array of fabrics and colors meticulously curated by Marta Ferri.

A seamless marriage of form and function, the Boboli armchair combines with the sofa from the same family creating an elegant and comfortable retreat for outdoor living, further enriching the legacy of the Molteni&C design narrative.
